rationale: All three HPC retention rings sit with one Tier 2 shop now in receivership. Meridian is already approved and only needs a contract; Valcourt PMA needs customer acceptance on two fleets.
Kemuning financial health fell 24 points in a year and its lender reports a covenant breach. Both candidates already hold approvals on this bracket family.
The N2 speed sensor is sole source and now under individual export licensing. A Singapore distributor holds licensed stock as a bridge while an alternate part number is qualified.
LPT seal ring output is at 40% for six weeks. Takamori is approved but carries no open volume; a standing 20% share would have absorbed this outage.
EU-origin acoustic panels face a 25% duty on US-routed flows from 1 Nov. A US source removes the exposure for US-bound work.
Translating sleeve repair is sole source with a strategic supplier under cash pressure. A second repair station protects the nacelle line.
Both north Taiwan fastener plants share one flood plain. A standing 25% share outside the region removes the single point of failure.
SmCo magnets are sole source and now under export licensing. A European distributor holds licensed stock as a bridge.
Daejeon NCRs are up to 7 in 12 months and a 400 piece batch failed receiving. Ohio Valley is approved and can hold a 20% share.
